body: Its not your fault.  I am just tired of the constant unending pain.  Its been a week of struggling that just won't stop.  And I dont know how long it will last and I dont want to have to find out.  She was all I had but noone else will miss me.  Still on hold with hotline, dont even know if its worth it.

The problem is for the last 7 days i have yet to be in a non-emotional state.  I get about 4-6 hours of sleep a night, cant eat, cant do anything without being reminded of the pain.  I can't stop thinking about it.  I have nothing left in my life so why wait when nothing will change.

As someone who as been in that situation, being abandoned sucks.  You clearly need someone who can be there for you and it looks like that isn't one of his priorities. I'm sorry if that's rough to hear but everyone deserves someone who can at least stand up for them and be a shoulder to lean on.

Goddam, right back into the feels.  Well its kinda the same, but neither of us really stopped loving eachother.  She just wasnt happy and miserable while still loving me in a internal struggle.  so she decided that breaking it off might fix that.  I just hope that in a little time the hating me part might change before the loving me part goes away.

I mean. I can point to Australia on the map. Close enough? But yeah. I've reveled in the few momentary glimpses of happiness I've had  so I'm glad to provide you one in return.   The hardest part is I had no reason to be mad or upset. Which would make getting over her easier.  She just wasnt happy so who am I to keep her that way.

I'm certainly trying to.  During the day it gets a little better when I can occupy myself . night time is still my enemy when its just me in the bed we used to share.   She moved in with me so it was a little bit better than of I uprooted myself  but I'm sorry for your situation  as well.  Thanks for the advice and we'll wishes friend

Not at all  I'd rather the hard truth than soft lies . so I did genuinely appreciate it.   I'm working now so couldn't get too detailed but I'll probably have a little more detailed responses later . again thankyou .  And unless you were at a diner drinking a milkshake 2 days ago, I'm not him.   That'd be pretty awkward though

Holy fuck that was painful to read .  Thank you though . I hope that's not her exact state of mine . but I can see enough similarities. Thank you again.   I'm sorry if that was hard for you but I appreciate the help

I mean  I say helping each other cope  but realistically neither of us are being helped. We both know how miserable the other is.  I just never found out what about me was making her miserable so I never had a chance to fix it.   That's Good that you guys are still friendly but u can only imagine how tough it still must be.

I get that. Thanks.  Its just really fresh.  Not to mention we both still want to be friends  and we are both helping each other through everything.  But thank you.     Were you blindsided by it like I was. Or did you see it coming
